resources.string: LipaBill uses Accessibility only to fill M-Pesa USSD menus for a payment you already confirmed in the app. It acts only while a payment session is active, reads dialer/USSD screens needed for that session, and does not read SMS or control unrelated apps. Your M-Pesa PIN is entered on LipaBill’s secure keypad, sent once into the PIN prompt, and is never stored.
